name: ash_enterprise_assets
description: Client-side dependencies. Kept minimal: everything else is Phoenix + Tailwind, vendored via mix. bpmn-js and dmn-js are the exception -- a process designer and a decision-table editor are real editors with no server-rendered equivalent; the ash_bpmn and ash_decisions hooks import them, the host owns the dependency. Both carry the bpmn.io licence, whose texts are byte-identical: the watermark must stay visible and unoverlapped, which constrains CSS and screenshot cropping alike. See docs/manifesto/06-reversibility.md for the cost this represents.
